assessments.summary: Ebola cases are peaking in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with sustained high-level transmission, causing 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths as of 3 November 2026.
Global flu test positivity is increasing, with 9.2% of tests positive this week compared to 7.8% a month ago, and US flu hospitalizations are up 76% from last year.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are at baseline with a score of 54/100, showing a slight increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
Global RSV test positivity has risen, with US hospital admissions increasing this week compared to last month.
Norovirus news coverage is rising, with increased Wikipedia readership indicating growing public interest.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are at baseline with a slight increase from the previous month, while Wikipedia readership is very low.
Cholera news coverage is rising, with increased Wikipedia readership indicating growing public interest.
Hepatitis A cases in the US are at baseline with a slight decrease in reported cases this year compared to last year.
Chikungunya cases in the US are falling, with fewer reported cases this year compared to last year.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 73/100 score, showing a sharp increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 72/100 score, indicating a significant rise in reported cases this year compared to last year.
Malaria cases in the US are rising with a 61/100 score, showing a moderate increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
West Nile virus cases in the US are rising with a 60/100 score, showing a dramatic increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
Pertussis cases in the US are rising with a 58/100 score, indicating a notable increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
Mpox cases in the US are at baseline with a 56/100 score, showing a moderate increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
